sections.heading: What is trending: “grote markt”
paragraphs: “grote markt” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for BE (snapshot taken 2026-10-17T18:30:56+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 200 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from De Morgen, HLN, VRT. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “VIDEO Angèle viert nieuw album met openluchtshow op Brusselse Grote Markt” — VRT
“KIJK. Angèle stelt nieuwe plaat voor tijdens gratis concert in Brussel, duizenden fans trotseren de regen” — HLN

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Sat, 17 Oct 2026 11:20:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-10-17T18:30:56+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-10-17T18:31:23+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
